currentParagraphText: “Depends, should I be nervous? Is it true that your planet has a lot of water?” the dragonkin asked, Scarlett fully aware of his extreme hydrophobia.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Depends, should I be nervous? Is it true that your planet has a lot of water?” the dragonkin asked, Scarlett fully aware of his extreme hydrophobia.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “It has, the majority of the surface is covered in it,” Scarlett answered honestly.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: That’s right, Draskil had also decided he wanted to tag along to Earth. In truth, his status within the Order of the Malefic Viper surpassed Scarlett’s by a fair margin, but the dragonkin had insisted she become the official leader of this little trip, as not only was she a native of the planet, but because he seriously didn’t want to be in charge of anything. If a situation didn’t have to do with fighting or women, Draskil very rarely bothered getting involved.
